message.content:
The volume \(V\) of a cone is given by

\[
V=\frac{1}{3}\pi r^{2}h .
\]

With a base radius \(r=3\;\text{cm}\) and height \(h=5\;\text{cm}\):

\[
V=\frac{1}{3}\pi(3)^2(5)=\frac{1}{3}\pi(9)(5)=\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)=15\pi \;\text{cm}^{3}.
\]

Numerically,

\[
V \approx 15 \times 3.14159 \approx 47.12\;\text{cm}^{3}.
\]
